requirement: Soft delete a treatment protocol and cascade the soft delete to all of its treatments inside one transaction, leaving other rows untouched, and report an unknown or already-deleted id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live treatment protocol exists for the target id
The protocol owns the treatments seeded for the case
The target id matches no live protocol, or it is already soft-deleted

inputs.text: Second delete request for an already deleted protocol
Delete request with an unknown protocol id
Delete a protocol holding one treatment (Mild, Outpatient)
Delete a protocol holding one treatment (Severe, IntensiveCareUnit)
Delete request for a protocol that was soft deleted beforehand
Delete a protocol holding several treatments
Delete a protocol that has no treatment

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the protocol is soft-deleted
Every treatment of the protocol is soft-deleted in the same transaction
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Treatment protocol not found' error

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or already-deleted protocol is returned as a failed Result
